code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                pts = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(abs(dr) + 1)]
                segments.append((pts, sr, sc))
                for r, c in pts:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    # A 6 lying on a 1-to-1 diagonal marks a perpendicular full diagonal.
    for pts, sr, sc in segments:
        on_segment = set(pts)
        for r, c in sixes:
            if (r, c) not in on_segment:
                continue
            # Continue along the opposite diagonal direction through the 6.
            r0, c0 = r, c
            while 0 <= r0 - sr < h and 0 <= c0 + sc < w:
                r0 -= sr
                c0 += sc
            while 0 <= r0 < h and 0 <= c0 < w:
                out[r0][c0] = 6
                r0 += sr
                c0 -= sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
print('saved', p)
